channel.title: Naail Food & Beverages
channel.description: Recent content on Naail Food & Beverages

item.title: Third water line commissioned at Sheikhupura
item.description: We have commissioned a third drinking-water bottling line at the Sheikhupura plant, taking water capacity from 38,000 to 60,000 bottles a day.

item.title: Mango intake for 2026 closes 12% above last season
item.description: This year’s mango pulp intake closed at 12% above the 2025 season, despite a start delayed by roughly two weeks in the Rahim Yar Khan belt.

item.title: ISO 22000 recertified through 2028
item.description: The Sheikhupura plant has been recertified to ISO 22000:2018 following a three-day audit in April, with the certificate now valid through August 2028.

item.title: NAAIL MANGO NECTAR
item.description: The drink the company was built on. Forty percent mango pulp from Multan and Rahim Yar Khan, with no artificial colour and no added preservative.

item.title: NAAIL CITRUS PUNCH
item.description: A blend of orange and kinnow concentrate from the Sargodha belt, lighter and sharper than our mango line.

item.title: NAAIL FIZZ
item.description: Three carbonated flavours produced on our 2016 line: Naail Cola, Naail Lemon-Lime and Naail Ginger.

item.title: NAAIL DRINKING WATER
item.description: Drawn from two on-site bores, treated by reverse osmosis and UV, and bottled on a dedicated line that handles nothing else.

item.title: NAAIL SNACKS
item.description: Our dry snack division opened in 2018 in a separate hall on the Sheikhupura site, with its own intake, roasting and packing lines.
